capabilities: decode base64 data into local PNG files
rewrite note links to point to the PNG files
batch-process the current file or all vault files
extras: README ends with a request for financial support (donations).
motivation: To reduce markdown file size, improve portability, and keep images organized in dedicated folders instead of embedded in notes.
problem: Base64-encoded images inflate markdown files, making them large, hard to edit, and less portable outside Obsidian.
summary: Utility that scans notes for base64-encoded images, saves them as local PNG files, and rewrites the note links.
